item.text:
`Booknotes.update_work_id` inherits [CommonExtras.update_work_id](/app/openlibrary/core/db.py:27). When an update hits a uniqueness conflict, its fallback explicitly deletes the source row at [db.py:74](/app/openlibrary/core/db.py:74). The [booknotes primary key](/app/openlibrary/core/schema.sql:12) explains how two notes for the same user and edition can collide.

A fix should preserve every booknote on conflict and return `{"rows_changed": 0, "rows_deleted": 0, "failed_deletes": 1}`. The inherited method currently returns a tuple, and the [admin caller](/app/openlibrary/plugins/admin/code.py:247) converts its result to a list, so that caller also needs review if the return type changes.
